description: This file provides a package 'proxy' that supports various network proxy protocols, including SOCKS5, and manages proxy configuration via environment variables and URL schemes. It defines interfaces, functions for creating dialers, and internal mechanisms for environment variable lookup.

classes.name: Dialer
classes.description: Interface for establishing network connections via a proxy.

classes.name: Auth
classes.description: Struct holding authentication credentials for proxy connections.

classes.name: envOnce
classes.description: Struct for lazy environment variable lookup, ensuring it is done only once.

methods.name: FromEnvironment
methods.description: Returns a proxy dialer based on environment variables.

methods.name: FromEnvironmentUsing
methods.description: Returns a proxy dialer using environment variables and a specified fallback dialer.

methods.name: RegisterDialerType
methods.description: Registers a custom URL scheme with a function to create dialers.

methods.name: FromURL
methods.description: Creates a dialer from a URL and a fallback dialer.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variable value, once.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes environment variable value, called once.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the envOnce state, used in tests.
